description: DataNexa is a local, read-only database MCP gateway for AI agents. It routes SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and any JDBC-compatible database through a single localhost endpoint, enforces read-only access via SQL AST validation with row, time, and connection limits, and keeps a local audit trail of every query.
summary: DataNexa: A local database aggregation MCP tool that unifies multiple data sources behind a single MCP endpoint, giving AI agents read-only, controlled, and auditable access across databases.
